ios.desc:
Tailored for ambitious professionals, students, and anyone striving to speak English flawlessly.

From You:
"Super friendly: This is a great app, it was effortless to setup and I completed a microlesson in no time."
phpfour

"Well designed app: Very well designed and results are awesome and trackable."
Kiran6014

WHY ACCENT AI?

• Real-Time Feedback: Get instant corrections on your pronunciation and intonation as you speak. Our AI listens and guides you on the spot – it’s like having a personal accent coach 24/7.
• Industry-Specific Role-Plays: Practice with scenarios and dialogues from the tech, academic, and customer service worlds (and more). From IT team meetings to grad school presentations to customer support calls, Accent AI prepares you for the real situations you face

• Filler Words & Tempo Tracking: Unique metrics track your “um’s” and “uh’s” and speaking speed. Learn to eliminate filler words and control your pace for more polished, confident speech – a feature you won’t find in most language apps.

• Personalized Learning Path: Take a quick assessment and let Accent AI design a training journey just for you. Focus on your trouble sounds and problem habits. Our AI insights pinpoint exactly what to improve (maybe it’s that “th” sound or your sentence rhythm) and adjust your lessons automatically.

• Fun & Motivating: Earn feedback and badges as you improve. Engage in interactive exercises, from tongue-twisters to mock interviews. Track your progress on your personal dashboard – see your pronunciation score and fluency improve week by week.

WHO IS IT FOR?

STEM & IT Professionals: Nail those technical presentations and team meetings – no more being held back by pronunciation. Communicate your ideas clearly to colleagues and clients.

Graduate Students & Academics: Defend your thesis or present research with confidence. Let your expertise shine, not just your accent.

Customer Service & Call Center Agents: Communicate with international customers smoothly. Sound professional and build trust over the phone.

Job Seekers & Public Speakers: Impress in interviews, networking, and public speaking engagements. Speak English as if it were second nature and open new career opportunities.

English Learners (Intermediate & Up): If you’ve mastered basic grammar and vocabulary, Accent AI takes you to the next level – polishing your accent and speaking clarity to native-like levels.

KEY FEATURES:


Progress Analytics: Dive into detailed stats – Accent AI sco

Hi HN — I built Accent AI, an iOS/Android pronunciation + public speaking coach.

What it does:
- Listen to short prompts and give feedback on pronunciation, stress/intonation, pacing, and breathing.
- A “meeting mode” style practice for clearer speech under pressure (stage anxiety / speaking confidence).

Why I built it:
I work with many non-native English speakers who can write English well but aren’t understood quickly in calls/interviews. I wanted fast, targeted drills that focus on clarity (not just vocabulary).
